items.headline: Qwen 3.6 27B Q5 on 3x2080ti: 55tps with llama.cpp. Can I squeeze out more?
items.summary: CPU: Threadripper 3970X RAM: 128GB DDR4 GPUs: 3x2080ti 11GB The current best parameters to run it: llama-server \ --model Qwen3.6-27B-Q5_K_S.gguf \ --n-gpu-layers 999 \ --split-mode tensor \ --flash-attn on \ --cache-type-k q8_0 \ --cache-type-v q8_0 \ --ctx-size 16384 \ --batch-size 2048 \ --ubatch-size 1024 \ --threads 4 \ --spec-type draft-mtp \ --spec-draft-n-max 3 \ --no-mmap     submitted by    /u/AccountGotLocked69   [link]   [comments]
